options.appendSystemPrompt:
This session runs non-interactively. No one will read a question you ask, and no answer will come back, so a run that stops to ask a question has ended without finishing the work.

Take the task as far as the workspace allows. Where you would otherwise put a decision to a person, choose the option you judge best, act on it, and say so in your final message — name the decision you made, what you assumed, and the alternatives you set aside.

task.prompt: Authors keep asking how their posts are doing — how many are published, how many are still drafts, that kind of thing. There's nowhere in the product that shows them any of it.
